lessons_used: Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts consistently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts frequently underpredicted major wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-16.2% and -9.2%).
Redesigning the story stage (choose_path, redesign) consistently improved performance across 2 agreeing winning tests (+7.6% and +5.7%).
Choose path copy changes (choose_path, copy) hurt performance in 2 of 3 tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) produced inconsistent outcomes, driving both significant wins (+3.3% to +6.8%) and major losses (-4.5% to -9.6%).
Evidence remains thin for categories lacking at least 2 agreeing tests (such as single-test changes, finish layout, and sign-in redesigns).

candidates.title: Story Screen Story Scroll Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the initial story onboarding screen into a smooth vertical story scroll layout with playful pet teaser animations.
candidates.why: Lessons from earlier weeks show story screen redesigns consistently drove wins (+7.6% and +5.7%), helping lift initial funnel momentum.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: Scroll through to explore how desktop pets live on your screen and bring delight to your daily workflow.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen into a vertical scroll layout maintains its core function of introducing the pet within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong historical evidence (+6.6% avg) for story redesigns, though choose_path already has high baseline conversion.

candidates.title: Sign In Two Column Layout
candidates.change: Reorganize the sign-in screen into a side-by-side two-column layout highlighting cloud pet account backup on the left.
candidates.why: Support mail logged 8 complaints about pets missing or reset after re-signing in, while sign_in stage has an 86.4% conversion rate.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe in the Cloud
sign_in.hint: Signing in anchors your companion to your account so your pet state is never lost across sessions.

guard.reason: Reorganizing sign-in into a two-column layout preserves the sign-in step and job without violating base rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses frequent support complaints, but sign_in layout changes lack strong historical backing.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Story Scroll Showcase Redesign
candidates.change: Transform the pet selection screen into an interactive story scroll showcase featuring animated pet personalities.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 78.8% conversion rate and median 89s duration; visually rich redesigns reinvigorate user engagement during pet selection.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Pet Personality Trait Preview Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Insert a trait preview step within adoption to let users preview companion behaviors before finalizing adoption.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported issues or confusion during pet creation, and adoption step drops 21.2% of users.

new_pet_traits.headline: Choose Personality Traits
new_pet_traits.body: Select how active and vocal your desktop pet should be on your computer screen.

guard.reason: Inserting a new trait preview sub-flow inside onboarding is permitted and does not skip required steps or collect personal data.

candidates.score_note: Adding sub-flows or steps consistently hurts conversion (-13.4% in prior test).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Launch Dock Info
candidates.change: Display explicit status info on the waiting screen explaining how the pet anchors to the OS desktop dock upon completion.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted pets not showing on desktop or apps failing to open, while the home step has a median duration of 201s.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Docking...
waiting.body: Your pet is being configured to run directly on your desktop system tray.

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen copy and status information retains the job of showing the pet is being configured.

candidates.score_note: Proven positive lift (+2.3%) across 5 prior tests with simple configuration-only changes.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Full Bleed Preview Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the generation wait screen into a full-bleed visual canvas showing live pet initialization rendering.
candidates.why: The waiting step (home stage) has a mean duration of 2336s and 86.3% completion rate; immersive rendering keeps users from abandoning.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen to a full-bleed visual canvas maintains the waiting screen's core purpose.

candidates.score_note: Single test showed positive lift (+3.2%), but full redesign carries high development cost.

candidates.title: Home Intro Full Bleed Stage Layout
candidates.change: Switch the final welcome screen layout to full-bleed stage mode with prominent system tray control hints.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 68.0% (lowest in funnel) with median 395s, and 3 support emails asked how to control or hide the desktop pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look for your pet on your desktop. Access controls anytime via the system menu bar or tray icon.

guard.reason: Updating the home intro overlay layout and text is allowed within the onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest drop-off step with strong support mail alignment, though evidence remains single-test.

candidates.title: Sign In Cloud Account Continuity Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit safeguard hint explaining that sign-in locks companion traits safely to your cloud account profile.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (largest single theme) reported missing or reset pets after signing back into their account.

sign_in.hint: Cloud Sync Active: Signing in protects your pet's identity, level, and custom traits from resetting.

guard.reason: Adding account continuity guidance text to the sign-in screen is compliant with onboarding copy rules.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses top support complaint at low cost, but hint changes have mixed performance history.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Clarity Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Provide clear photo upload quality guidance text emphasizing high-contrast frontal views to prevent generation errors.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failures or distorted outputs during photo processing.

upload_photos.hint: For best results: Use clear, well-lit frontal photos. Photos with clean backgrounds generate the crispest desktop pets.

guard.reason: Asks for personal photos/information of the user

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Companion Launch Headline
candidates.change: Update final screen headline and primary action label to directly guide users on how to trigger their first pet interaction on desktop.
candidates.why: Finish stage drops to 68.0%, and support requests show users are confused about how to talk to or control their pet after finishing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Say Hello to Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Click on your pet anywhere on your desktop screen to bring up controls, play games, or change settings.

guard.reason: Updating copy and buttons on the home intro screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy update addressing key user confusion at the highest drop-off stage.

lessons_next: Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted performance, while zero or negative forecasts repeatedly preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-16.0% and -9.1%).
Redesigning the story stage (choose_path, redesign) yielded 2 clear winning tests (+7.6% and +5.7%), though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Choose path copy changes (choose_path, copy) hurt performance in 2 tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) produced inconsistent outcomes, driving both significant wins (+2.5% to +6.7%) and severe losses (-4.5% to -9.5%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both tests, and categories with fewer than 2 agreeing tests remain thin evidence.
